Stotra-arc: rite (v1) → scrutiny (vv2–4) → madness-bliss (v5) → sudden-means (v6) → riddles dissolved (vv7–10) → fixing (v11) → descent (vv12–15) → red rite (v16) → grasping goddess (vv17–20) → ordaining three (v21) → sporting ground (vv22–23) → garland (v24) → Śiva-made shining (v25) → time-making cover (v26, live-fork noted not litigated) → resort (v27) → bowing (v28) → all-folk grace (v29) → dated seal 991 CE (v30). lines: You swell sequence on that ground, mete Your powers' difference —
show always in Yourself, O god. Then triple-named — doing, knowing, willing, may I become triple, heart eager to overlay.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kramollāsaṃ tasyāṃ bhuvi viracayan | trirūpaṃ bhūyāsaṃ samadhiśayituṃ vyagrahṛdayaḥ

verses.craft: Swell-mete-show; triple-becoming prayed; samadhiśayitum overlay per UNC.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ['samadhiśayitum as overlay kept.']) / C1 essence / rasa vīra of becoming / L2+L3 voice (handcrafted, restored)
